title: PluginState
description: Plugin instance + parameter state (phase 3). Emitter contract, no additionalProperties:false (D-06). Chunked opaque plugin state (CLAP state extension / LV2 state:interface) persists as binary files under <project>/plugins/<instanceId>.state referenced from project v2 — never inline JSON (same rule as AMEV event chunks).

id.description: Instance uuid. A midi track binds it via instrumentId = 'plugin:<id>' (additive extension of set_track_instrument).

status.description: 'stub': registered but DSP not hosted yet (renders silence). 'active': live in the graph. 'crashed': isolation evolution — node emits silence + UI badge.

id.description: Stable per-plugin parameter id (CLAP param id / LV2 control-port index). Automation targets (targetNode=instanceId, paramId=id) use this.

paramChange.description: One element of plugin_set_param's batched changes array (D-03: born batch-shaped; a knob drag is one invoke with N changes, not N invokes).

persistedInstance.description: project v2 'plugins' array element: enough to re-instantiate and restore on open.

stateRef.description: Relative path to the chunked state blob, e.g. plugins/<id>.state

params.description: Fallback param snapshot for plugins without a state interface.
